title: TOUR GRUPAL PERU 2026
description:
We invite you to an accessible group tour through Lima, Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, and Rainbow Mountain.
You will travel with safety, personalized assistance, and adapted routes for people with disabilities or reduced mobility.

In Lima, we will learn about its history and gastronomy with accessible tours.
In Cusco and the Sacred Valley, you will enjoy incredible landscapes with adapted vehicles, technical support, and sufficient time for each visit.
In Machu Picchu, we will accompany you step by step with specialized guides and circuits designed for everyone.
And to close, the Rainbow Mountain — in its accessible version — will be the cherry on top of the trip.

💚 Traveling without limits is possible.
📧 contact@accessibletravelperu.com
📞 +51 944 731 223

Accessible Travel Peru — adventure is for everyone.
includes: Tourist hotel (Adapted hotel with flat showers)
Official tour guide (Guides specialized in accessible tourism)
Support staff (Staff for support throughout the trip)
Entrances and trains (Entrances to tourist attractions and round-trip train tickets)
Tours and excursions (All tours and excursions described in the itinerary)
Water & snacks (1 bottle of water and snacks)
excludes: International flights (Flights to and from your country)
Other (Items not mentioned in this program)

itinerary.title: Welcome to Peru! 😀 🛬
itinerary.description:
Arrival in Lima. Our team will be waiting for you at the airport with a warm smile 😊 to provide you with all the personalized assistance you need.

🚐 Then, we will transfer you in adapted transportation, designed to offer comfort and safety to all travelers, including people with disabilities or reduced mobility ♿.

🏨 Upon arrival, check-in will be done at an adapted hotel, with accessible rooms, ramps, and bathrooms conditioned for your total comfort.

🌙 Free night and overnight in Lima, to rest and prepare for the adventures to come.

itinerary.title: City Tour in Lima – Tradition and Modernity 🇵🇪
itinerary.description:
After breakfast 🥐, we will begin an exciting City Tour through Lima, discovering its unique blend of history, culture, and modernity.

🚐 We will start the tour through the elegant districts of Miraflores and San Isidro, where we will enjoy their beautiful parks, ocean views, and modern architecture.

🏛️ Then we will visit the impressive Huaca Pucllana archaeological site, a pre-Inca jewel in the middle of the city.

We will continue to the Historic Center of Lima, declared a World Heritage Site, where we will admire its squares, colonial balconies, and the majestic Church and Convent of Santo Domingo ⛪.

🍽️ At the end of the tour, we will enjoy lunch at an accessible local restaurant, with delicious Peruvian gastronomy.

Finally, return to the hotel in adapted transportation to rest and enjoy free time in the afternoon 🌇.

Overnight in Lima.

itinerary.title: Off to Cusco – The Capital of the Inca Empire 🇵🇪
itinerary.description:
In the morning, after breakfast 🍳, we will transfer to the airport in adapted transportation to take the flight to Cusco, the ancient capital of the Inca Empire.

🛬 Upon arrival, our team will welcome you with a warm welcome and personalized assistance 😊. Then, transfer to the adapted hotel, where you can rest and acclimatize to the altitude.

🌞 In the afternoon we will begin a fascinating City Tour of Cusco, starting with the Main Square, surrounded by colonial churches and streets full of history. We will continue to the Qoricancha Temple, known as the Temple of the Sun, a jewel of Inca and colonial art.

🏛️ Then we will explore the nearby archaeological complexes, such as Sacsayhuamán and Tambomachay, and take a panoramic tour of Qenqo and Puca Pucará, enjoying their imposing landscapes and mysterious architecture.

🚐 At the end, return to the hotel in adapted transportation to rest and prepare for the next day.

Overnight in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Full Day – Wonders of the Sacred Valley of the Incas 🌾
itinerary.description:
After breakfast 🍳, we will depart in adapted transportation to the fascinating Sacred Valley of the Incas, a place full of history, imposing landscapes, and living culture.

🏺 Our first stop will be at the Pisac archaeological complex, where we will admire its agricultural terraces and Inca constructions. Then we will visit the colorful Pisac artisan market, ideal for appreciating the work of local artisans and acquiring unique souvenirs 🎨.

🚐 We will continue our tour through the charming towns of Lamay, Yucay and Yanahuara, until we reach the heart of the valley: Urubamba, surrounded by mountains and green fields.

🍽️ Here we will enjoy a delicious buffet lunch in an accessible restaurant, with a wide selection of typical regional dishes.

In the afternoon, we will visit the imposing Ollantaytambo archaeological complex, one of the most impressive fortresses of the Inca world, known for its amazing engineering and beauty.

🌇 At the end of the day, we will return to Cusco in adapted transportation to rest.

Overnight in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Full Day – Adventure at the Rainbow Mountain 🌈⛰️
itinerary.description:
Very early, around 5:00 a.m., we will begin our excursion to the famous Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), one of the most spectacular landscapes in Peru.

🚐 The tour is done in adapted transportation, providing safety and comfort during the journey. Along the way we will enjoy beautiful high Andean landscapes, herds of llamas and alpacas 🦙, and traditional towns that preserve their ancestral culture.

🥪 A box lunch will be provided to enjoy during the route, ideal for replenishing energy while admiring the natural beauty of the environment.

🌈 Upon arrival, we will be able to appreciate the incredible Mountain of Seven Colors, a natural spectacle formed by minerals that create unique tones of red, green, yellow, and blue. It will be an unforgettable experience, full of nature and Andean energy.

After the visit, return to Cusco in adapted transportation to rest.

Overnight in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Andean Communities – Chincheros 🧵🏔️
itinerary.description:
After breakfast 🍳, we will depart to the Cuper Bajo community, in the Chinchero area, to live an authentic cultural experience with the local inhabitants.

👩‍🌾 During the visit, we will learn about their ancient weaving and natural dyeing techniques for textiles, made with alpaca and sheep wool, and dyed with natural products such as plants, flowers, and minerals 🌿.

We will also have the opportunity to learn about their daily life, their customs, and their connection with the land, discovering how they produce their food and crafts with ancestral wisdom.

🔥 Then, we will participate in the preparation of a Pachamanca, a delicious traditional dish cooked underground with hot stones — a unique gastronomic and cultural experience in the Andes. This will be our lunch of the day 🍽️.

In the afternoon, return to Cusco in adapted transportation to rest and enjoy free time in the evening 🌙.

Overnight in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Full Day – Wonder of the World: Machu Picchu 🏯🌄
itinerary.description:
Very early, after breakfast 🍳, we will depart to the train station 🚆 to begin our journey to Machu Picchu, one of the Seven Wonders of the Modern World and the jewel of the Inca legacy.

During the journey we will enjoy impressive landscapes of the Sacred Valley, with mountains, rivers, and valleys that will accompany us to the town of Aguas Calientes. From there we will take the adapted bus that will take us to the entrance of the sanctuary.

🗿 We will take a guided tour of Machu Picchu, a tour designed to appreciate the main constructions of the lower area of Machu Picchu.

It is an ideal circuit to experience the magic of Machu Picchu in a more accessible and comfortable way, allowing you to fully enjoy its history, spirituality, and unique landscapes ✨.

🍽️ At the end of the visit, we will enjoy an included lunch at a local restaurant before boarding the return train to Cusco.

🚐 Arrival in Cusco and transfer to the adapted hotel to rest.

Overnight in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Time to say goodbye… See you soon, Peru! 🇵🇪 ✈️
itinerary.description:
After breakfast 🍳, at the indicated time we will transfer to Cusco airport in adapted transportation 🚐 to take the return flight to Lima.

Upon arrival, our team will assist you at Lima airport to make the connection with your international flight 🌍.

It will be the closing of an unforgettable experience, full of history, landscapes, and special shared moments 💛.

Thank you for traveling with Accessible Travel Peru, we look forward to seeing you again to continue discovering the wonders of Peru together in an accessible and safe way! ♿🇵🇪
